_comment: Entries render top to bottom in this order (newest first). track: work | oss | edu. Optional "points" renders as a bullet list. Entries with "draft": true show a badge locally and make `build.py --release` fail, so nothing unfinished gets published.

es: [Architect Study Hub](https://toniferr.github.io/architect-study-hub/): arquitectura, plataforma, IA y cloud, con asistente de estudio con IA.
[Math of AI](https://toniferr.github.io/math-of-ai/es/): las matemáticas y la historia de la IA, de los autómatas a los LLM.
[Math of Quantum](https://toniferr.github.io/math-of-quantum/es/): las matemáticas de la computación cuántica, con un simulador de cúbits.
[Calculus × Computing](https://toniferr.github.io/calculus-computing/es/): un mapa del cálculo universitario y de dónde aparece en la informática.
en: [Architect Study Hub](https://toniferr.github.io/architect-study-hub/): architecture, platform, AI and cloud, with an AI study assistant.
[Math of AI](https://toniferr.github.io/math-of-ai/): the mathematics and history of AI, from automata to LLMs.
[Math of Quantum](https://toniferr.github.io/math-of-quantum/): the mathematics of quantum computing, with a qubit simulator.
[Calculus × Computing](https://toniferr.github.io/calculus-computing/): a map of university calculus and where it shows up in computing.
gl: [Architect Study Hub](https://toniferr.github.io/architect-study-hub/): arquitectura, plataforma, IA e cloud, con asistente de estudo con IA.
